# Edit those, then apply with:  ./sandbox reload

# SANDBOX_AGENT=claude. Swap agents with:  ./sandbox agent codex

# --- Claude Code: login, updates and connectors -----------------------------
# Needed only if you authenticate the CLI interactively (`./sandbox login`) or
# let it update itself. On an API-key-only setup you can delete this block —
# every line is a destination data could leave through.
claude.ai
claude.com
code.claude.com
platform.claude.com
downloads.claude.ai
bridge.claudeusercontent.com
mcp-proxy.anthropic.com

# storage.googleapis.com is deliberately NOT here. The CLI's release artifacts
# live in a bucket on it, but profile/claude/settings.json sets
# DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 (the rootfs is read-only, so an update could not land
# anyway) and ./sandbox upgrade rebuilds the image on the host instead. With no
# updater left to feed, all the host would offer is an exfiltration channel —
# it is a shared bucket host, so anyone can create a bucket there and PUT to a
# signed URL. Add it back only if you re-enable self-update in the profile.

# Homebrew's formula index — only needed if the agent installs via brew.
# formulae.brew.sh

# Agent-independent half of the egress allowlist. One host per line; `#`
# comments and blank lines are fine. A leading dot matches the domain and
# every subdomain beneath it.
#
# The file squid reads (allowlist.txt) is GENERATED from this file plus
# proxy/agents/<agent>.txt for whichever agent is active. Edit and apply with:
#     ./sandbox allow <domain> --reason '<why>'   (or edit here + ./sandbox reload)
# Everything not listed is unreachable from the agent container; anything on
# proxy/never-allow.txt is refused by `allow` and flagged by `reload`.

# --- Source hosting ---------------------------------------------------------

# ssh.github.com (the SSH-over-443 endpoint used by deploy keys).

# .gitlab.com covers gitlab.com and altssh.gitlab.com.
